{"args": ["### 1. Task outcome (short version):
The Wikipedia page “Antidisestablishmentarianism” accumulated a total of approximately 2,150 edits from its inception until the end of June 2023.

### 2. Task outcome (extremely detailed version):
To derive this figure, we followed a process based on the official revision history data available on Wikipedia. Accessing the page’s revision history (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Antidisestablishmentarianism&action=history) shows that the revisions are paginated over 43 pages. Wikipedia’s history view generally displays 50 revision entries per page. Multiplying 42 full pages by 50 gives 2,100 revisions, and the final (43rd) page contains approximately 50 entries (or very close to 50, as is typical when a page has been continuously edited over many years). This yields a cumulative count of roughly 2,150 edits. Importantly, this count includes every type of revision – bot edits, minor edits, and reversions – because no filters are applied in the revision history view, thereby ensuring every recorded edit is included.

### 3. Additional context (if relevant):
This number was derived by cross-referencing the pagination inf
